The '''''Champion's Glory''''' was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Varad]]. In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref> the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] participated in the [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|assault]] on the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]''.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

[[File:ChampionsGloryVarad.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Champion's Glory'' during the [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|Attack on the ''Spirit of Vengeance II'']]]]
The ''Champion's Glory'' was a warship built by modifying the internal structure and components of a civilian vessel, to the point that the only recognizable part of the original ship was its outer hull, which had been heavily reinforced. Clan Varad optimized the ship for ship-to-ship combat, as the vessel was for use in the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]]. The ship was armed with an [[Advanced Deployment Harpoon]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Champion's Glory}}</ref>
